Escrow Holdback Quick Tips

If the borrower asks about holdbacks, remember:
- 90 days maximum
- FHA and USDA: 1x repair cost
- VA and Conventional: 1.5x repair cost

Steps:
1. Add the special feature.
2. Get the contractor invoice.
3. Order the final inspection.

Questions? Email processortraining@canopymortgage.com or call 480-555-0100.
